column2: I do not know who killed the three Dunmer at the east end of Lilmoth Dock. It is about seventy paces north-east of here. They were armed, and they died anyway.
Wild leeks grow about twenty paces north-west of here. Yellow mountain flower grows down by the water, a dozen paces south-south-west. A poison bloom grows about forty paces east-south-east.
Three Dunmer lie dead and unburied at the east end of Lilmoth Dock, a man and two women. It is about seventy paces north-east of here.
I am a thief. I work the road to the dock with the other thief by the leeks. I know where the dead lie and what they carry, but I have not gone to see yet.
